summary: Full-stack test of FamigliaTask MVP. Backend: 26/26 pytest cases passed (auth, family, members RBAC, PIN verify, activities compito/impegno with RBAC, complete/uncomplete points sync, leaderboard, presets=10). Frontend: end-to-end mobile flow verified — landing -> create-family -> Oggi -> add compito via activity sheet (preset+points+assignee) -> compito shows in 'Da fare' and moves to 'Fatti' with points reflected in header when toggled complete. Profilo accent change, manage-members add/edit/delete testIDs present, switch-user shows PIN pad; wrong PIN keeps user on PIN pad, correct PIN logs the member in. As 'membro' (Luca) the activity sheet correctly shows only 'Nuovo impegno' (no compito/impegno type toggle) — RBAC enforced on UI. No deprecated Expo packages detected. Only cosmetic RN-Web console warnings (shadow*/pointerEvents).

issues: RN-Web console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow); 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' — cosmetic only, non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: silence RN-Web deprecation warnings by migrating shadow* props to boxShadow and pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents.

Note for future testers: pytest config uses xdist loadscope; the module-scoped fixture that mutates state across classes only works when run serially (-n 0). This file is safe to run either way but was validated with -n 0.

Note: Review request mentioned 'accent_color: azure' but frontend/theme exposes accents: coral, mint, amber, pink, teal, berry. Backend accepts any string. Consider aligning docs/tests to a fixed accent set.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly separated (routes, serializers, RBAC helper). Uses uuid-based ids, soft delete via deleted_at, and Bearer session tokens with expireAfterSeconds index — good.
RBAC correctly enforced server-side for members and activities (capo vs membro; own vs others).
MongoDB _id excluded from all responses via projection {_id: 0}. Good.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and testIDs on all key interactive elements. No hardcoded URLs.
Auth flow supports both Google (redirect) and device family creation. Session persisted via secureStore.
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_* families created via /api/family/create during pytest and Playwright runs (soft-delete + fresh family per run). No cleanup performed; data prefixed with TEST_ for identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use pytest with '-n 0' (serial) because module-scoped capo_ctx fixture is mutated across classes; xdist loadscope splits classes across workers. Frontend session persists via secureStore (fam_session_token) and may auto-restore in the same browser context; use a fresh incognito context or perform full E2E in a single Playwright session. PIN pad testIDs are 'pin-key-<digit>' and 'pin-key-del' (not 'pin-<digit>'). Bottom tab bar has no explicit tab testIDs; navigate by tapping x-coordinates or by role/href.
